notes.title: Based On Player Feedback I Have Changed...
notes.notes:
There is now an exit button. I know, it seems like something everything should have, but in all honesty I thought that once you started playing Catsapults you would never want to stop playing it. My feelings are hurt.

A new level was added. This level was designed to educate the player on two mechanics: Pushing crates into water to cover water, and using boxes to collect kittens. Those two mechanics were not taught to the player before a level which employed both of those. 

Someone had a super big screen and it was making the map all discombobulated. While a rare case, I don't want a single customer's experience ruined by something I could fix. Thus the max screen size was adjusted to what it was developed in for perfection.

Thanks for the feedback everyone!

notes.title: 08/27 WEEK LONG DEAL! 80% Off!
notes.notes:
These prices are so low I must be crazy! Experience the fun and exciting world of Catsapults for only $99 cents. I’m practically giving it away! This is highway robbery!

You’ll be in for a treat with this steal. If you can ignore the epileptic flashing caused by the html you’ll find yourself neck deep in pussy cat. A whole boat load of adorable kittens in many flavors. If you know anything about Twine you’ll be like wow, this is the most awesome Twine game of them all. How is this even possible?

Through obsessive year-long programming and bug squashing good sir! That’s how. This game was carefully designed to provide a solid experience from start to finish. What does that mean? The game evolves by introducing new mechanics, new graphics, new music, new sounds. Indeed I would be heartbroken if anybody considered Catsapults to be described as repetitive.

Have you always wanted a game about a cop chasing a leprechaun? Well that’s weird and we should be friends. Buy Catsapults today, so I can reach the threshold needed to make cat emojies. It’s for a good cause!
